quotations.old_english: Swift wæs on fóre, fuglum frumra
quotations.english: it was swift in its course, more rapid than birds

source_text: frum; comp. frumra; adj. Vigorous, strenuous, prompt, quick, rapid; str&e-long;nuus :-- Swift wæs on fóre, fuglum frumra it was swift in its course, more rapid than birds, Exon. 113 b; Th. 434, 21; Rä. 52, 4. v. from.
